temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual. When Jose asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff, thanks him for asking, and appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant at work, and Jose has no specific knowledge of any trouble she is facing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jose now believes Patricia is dealing with an undisclosed personal issue and appreciates having someone available to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia has some personal troubles, is not ready to share details, but values Jose's support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and slight hopefulness from being able to offer support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be available to listen and support Patricia without pressing her for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. When he offers financial planning discussion, she says she has been overwhelmed by bills and may take him up on it soon.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has an undisclosed personal issue and appreciates Jose's offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jose learns that Patricia's personal stress includes financial strain, and his concern deepens.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is overwhelmed by bills and financial commitments, and she may be open to practical budgeting or financial-planning help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and cautious willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer practical financial-planning or budgeting support and wait until Patricia feels ready to discuss it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia tells Jose she did not think he was prying, is grateful for his offer, and appreciates that he respects her privacy. Jose apologizes for possibly overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed, and Jose worries that bringing up financial planning may have overstepped her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Patricia's reassurance corrects Jose's worry: she welcomes his support and does not feel he overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values Jose's help and does not think he is prying; he can continue supporting her as a respectful friend.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initial worry and uncertainty, then relief and warmth.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure Patricia that he respects her privacy and to continue being a supportive friend without pushing.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is good and that she plans a quiet weekend at home. She does not share further personal details, but thanks Jose and says she will keep him in mind if she needs anything.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates Jose's concern but likely prefers to handle her personal and financial issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — the interaction confirms that Patricia values his support while maintaining privacy and handling things on her own terms.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates Jose's availability but does not currently want active involvement in her personal issues; low-pressure support is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, warmth, and restrained attentiveness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To remain friendly and available without prying, offering casual check-ins and support only if she asks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia values Jose's support but prefers privacy and low-pressure check-ins while she manages her issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change — this reinforces Jose's belief that Patricia is coping and appreciates his supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and values Jose's regular support, but she does not require active intervention unless she asks for it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue offering regular, low-pressure support and practical help such as grabbing coffee, while respecting her independence.
